newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, October 28 - Varna - East - 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 3 awaiting orders. West - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Lesport, tankers - No vessels. Bourgas - East - 11 Vessels due, 10 loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 10 Vessels repair/drydock. West - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Tankers - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. October 21 to 27 - Bourgas - Fifty-four vessels operating of which 30 loading, 5 general, 2 fishmeal, 1 zinc, 2 metal, 2 copper, 1 timber, 1 alcohol, 4 ammonia nitrate, 1 bentonite, 1 urea, 2 steel coils, 1 pipes, 1 cars, 2 gasoil, 2 benzene, 1 chemicals, 1 empty vessel.

Eighteen discharging, 1 zinc concentrate, 3 fishmeal, 1 salt, 1 steel, 2 coal, 2 copper concentrate, 1 urea, 1 wheat, 1 sugar, 1 iron ore, 3 petrol, 1 ethanol. 5 Discharging/loading, 1 salt/timber, 1 containers/general, 1 general, 2 containers. 10 Vessels under repair. 12 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load copper, 4 To discharge (1 sugar, 1 petrol, 1 ethanol, 1 coal). 3 Vessels awaiting orders, 4 cargo not nominated. 11 Vessels due of which 8 to load, 2 ammonia nitrate, 1 metal, 1 coils, 1 tobacco, 1 iron, 1 chemicals, 1 benzene. 1 To discharge copper concentrate, 2 To discharge/load (containers/timber, sugar/steel plates). Varna - 24 Vessels operating of which 11 loading (4 soda, 1 scrap, 1 clinker, 1 urea, 2 quartz sand, 1 edc, 1 sulphur acid). 6 Discharging, 1 marble, 1 rice, 3 coal, 1 trucks. 5 Discharging/loading trucks/containers. 3 Vessels waiting in roads, 3 Cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, October 28 - Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 5 loading at berth, 7 under repair/drydock. 2 Vessels berthed, 6 anchored, 4 due, delays expected. Rasa - One vessel berthed. Zadar - Two vessels due, delays expected. Sibenik - Two vessels due, delays expected. Split - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Ploce - Two vessels discharging at berth. Dubrovnik - One vessel due, delays expected. Pula - No vessels in port.

CYPRUS, October 29 - Limassol - Vessels due on 30/10, 5 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 5 passenger vessels, 1 cruise vessel. Delays expected. 4 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 3 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - One container vessel due on 30/10, 1 conventional vessel due, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, October 28 - Tallinn - Three vessels due, no delays expected. Kopli - Six vessels due, no delays expected. 3 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 flour, 2 fish. Muuga - Three vessels due, no delays expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth of which 2 black oil, 1 timber, 1 cars. 2 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 grain, 1 liquid. 2 Ferries in port. Parnu - Six vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Timber vessels loading at berth.

ITALY, October 29 - Naples - One gas tanker expected to berth 31/10. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Milazzo - 23 October refinery personnel on strike, expected to last until 7/11. Until 7/11 tugboat crews will not work on overtime. Multedo oil port - From 26/10, the maximum allowed draft for berthing inside is 46 ft. Three vessels in roads. 4 Vessels berthed. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, No delays. 42 Vessels berthed, 6 in drydock. Savona - One vessel in roads, no delays, none berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, none berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 9 berthed, 5 under repair. Leghorn - Six vessels in roads, 38 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads, No delays. Augusta - Two vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Syracuse - Three in roads. Palermo - No vessels in roads, No delays. Sarroch - Two vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto - 14 Vessels in roads totalling 792,535 dwt. Ravenna - No information. Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, No delays. Venice - Two vessels in roads. Trieste - Three vessels in roads, berthing delays.

LATVIA, October 29 - Riga - Ten vessels operating of which 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 1 cotton loader, 1 steel loader, 1 tanker loader, 1 scrap metal loader. 16 Vessels due, no berthing delays. Ventspils - Nine vessels in port of which 5 operating, 2 steel loaders, 1 steel billets loader, 1 zinc loader, 1 wood loader. 4 Vessels awaiting operations, no berthing delays. 11 Vessels due. Liepaja - Seven vessels operating, no berthing delays, no vessels due.
LITHUANIA, October 29 - Klaipeda - Vessels in port loading, 4 oil, 2 pellets, 2 scrap, 2 steel coils, 1 metal. Vessels discharging, 3 fish, 1 sugar. 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 4 in roads, 36 due.

NORWAY, October 27 - Narvik - The strike among the workers at Lkab Narvik, which has paralysed all iron ore handling since 26/9, was officially called off at 1245 hours on 27/10. Work at the plant commenced at 2200 hours 27/10. A vessel alongside expected to complete loading and sail by 28/10. Minor repairs to the shiploader will be carried out, and the loading system tested before the loading can recommence.

POLAND, October 29 - Szczecin - Ninety vessels due, 56 loading at berth, 34 discharging at berth. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 16 vessels under repair/drydock. Gdynia - Fifteen vessels operating. 1 Grain vessel awaiting turn. 5 Vessels loading at berth (1 coal, 1 bulk, 3 general cargo). 10 Vessels discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 7 grain, 1 bulk). 4 Vessels under repair/drydock, 26 due. Gdansk - Eleven vessels operating, 7 loading at berth (1 coal, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk, 2 tankers). 4 Vessels discharging at berth (2 bulk, 2 grain). 3 Vessels under repair/drydock, 17 due.
PORTUGAL, October 28 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 4 general cargo, 3 container vessels. No vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 10 piers with cranes, 2 without cranes.

ROMANIA, October 29 - Constantza - Thirty-nine vessels operating of which 19 generals (17 loading, 2 discharging), 12 bulkers (5 loading, 7 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker discharging, 1 bagged cement loading. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 bulkers loading, 2 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker loading. Constantza south (Agigea) - Five vessels loading general cargo. Mangalia - One bulker loading. Midia - No vessels loading/waiting.

RUSSIA, October 29 - Baltic ports - St. Petersburg - Twenty-one vessels operating of which loading, 5 non-ferrous, 2 paper, 2 containers, 2 fertiliser, 1 coal, 2 general cargo, 1 timber. Discharging, 1 malt, 2 frozen meat, 2 containers, 1 peas. 6 Vessels awaiting operation, 11 due. Kaliningrad - Eight vessels operating of which 2 fertiliser loading, 1 coal loader, 2 scrap metal loaders, 1 timber loader, 1 cellulose loader, 1 bananas discharger. No berthing delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - Three vessels operating, no berthing delays. 7 Vessels due. Far East ports - Vladivostok - Fourteen vessels in port of which 3 passenger vessels. 6 Vessels loading (3 metal, 1 timber, 1 cotton, 1 container). 1 General cargo discharging, 4 vessels waiting.

Nakhodka - Twelve vessels in port of which 6 loading (4 metal, 2 timber). 1 Techniques discharging, 5 vessels waiting. Vostochniy - Five vessels in port of which 4 loading (1 coal, 2 timber, 1 clinker). 1 Vessel waiting. Posyet - No vessels in port. Khasan - One vessel loading metal, no delays, no congestion in ports. Northern Basin - Murmansk - Seven vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 steel, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 aluminium, 2 cabotage. No vessels waiting, 4 due during the week of which 1 apatite loader, 3 dischargers of which 2 alumina, 1 cabotage. Black Sea - Novorossiysk - Twelve vessels operating of which 7 loading, 1 coal, 4 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 1 soya bean meal. 5 Discharging. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 3 to discharge. 33 Vessels due of which 24 to load, 1 scrap, 11 steel, 1 pipes, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 copper cathodes, 1 wire, 1 cellulose, 3 seeds, 1 logs, 1 urea, 1 ammonia, 1 vegetable oil. 9 To discharge, 2 rice, 1 castor oil, 1 bananas, 4 luggage, 1 cars. Oil terminal, 3 vessels loading of which 2 crude, 1 fuel oil. 10 vessels waiting in roads to load of which 7 crude, 2 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil. 7 Vessels due to load of which 5 crude, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil.

SLOVENIA, October 28 - Koper - Thirteen vessels due during next 2 days of which 4 containers for loading/discharging, 1 bulk carrier to load grain, 1 bulk carrier to discharge grain, 3 general cargo to load sawn timber, pipes, steel. 1 Reefer to discharge fruit, 1 car carrier to discharge cars, 1 livestock to load bulls, 1 chemical tanker to discharge chemicals. 12 Vessels berthed of which 3 bulk carriers discharging coal and alumina, 3 general cargo loading steel and sawn timber, 2 livestock loading bulls, 1 container vessel loading/discharging, 1 chemical tanker discharging chemicals, 1 reefer discharging fruit, 1 tanker discharging gasoline, no delays expected.

SPAIN, October 28 - Sagunto - Fourteen vessels operating of which 1 ro/ro discharging/loading, 1 discharging/loading steel products, 1 discharging/loading timber/general cargo, 6 discharging steel products, 1 loading perishable goods, 1 discharging logs, 1 discharging logs/timber, 2 discharging plump. No vessels berthed outside Commercial wharf, no berthing delays. October 29 - Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 2 loading steel products. 3 Discharging of which 1 steel, 1 acid, 1 ore. Gijon - Four vessels in port of which 1 discharging ore, 3 loading (1 butane gas, 1 cement, 1 steel). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. A stevedore strike commenced on 28/10 with intermittent stoppages. A solution to the strike is hopeful this week. Cadiz - Sixteen vessels in port of which 4 ro/ro, 1 tourist, 1 container vessel, 1 rice, 1 wheat, 1 sand, 1 shipbuilding material, 4 semolina. 2 vessels under repair, no delays. Pasajes - Eleven vessels in port of which 1 each discharging scrap, general cargo, sawn timber, fertiliser, granite, 2 discharging woodpulp, 3 loading steel. 1 vessel under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, October 30 - Istanbul - Hay-darpasa - 5 Vessels operating of which 3 containers, 1 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 vessels operating, port congested.

UKRAINE, Octtober 28 - Mariupol - Five vessels loading at berth (metal products, fertiliser, sunflowerseed), 4 discharging (oranges, sunflowerseed, spar, plastics), 3 waiting to load (metal products, fertiliser, sulphur). 9 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 28 vessels due (pig iron, sunflower seed, coal, general cargo, alumina, metal products, fertiliser). Kerch - One loading metals at berth, 1 loading manganese ore, 3 under repairs/drydock, 1 due. Berdiansk - One vessel loading metal products, 1 awaiting orders, 2 due. October 29 - Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 2 vessels alongside, 3 due. 3 Container vessels due. Grain cargo loading, 1 vessel alongside, 5 due. Sugar discharging, 1 due. Tanker loading, 1 alongside, 1 anchored. General cargo 2 due, fertiliser 4 due. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 5 alongside, 1 anchored. 3 Container vessels alongside. Tanker discharging, 1 alongside. General cargo, 2 alongside, 1 anchored. Mariupol - Ten vessels operating of which 4 loading, 4 discharging. 2 Cargo not nominated, 3 waiting in roads to load, 29 due. Odessa - 16 Vessels operating of which 7 loading, 2 waiting in roads, 1 bunkering, 19 due.
YUGOSLAVIA, October 29 - Bar - Two vessels berthed, 1 discharging bananas, 1 loading metal, no delays. Zelenika/Bijela - Two discharging fuel, 4 under repair, no delays.
